## Examples

```esql
FROM funnel_events
| STATS level = WINDOW_FUNNEL(1 hour, @timestamp, action == "view", action == "cart", action == "checkout", action == "purchase") BY user
| SORT user
```

| level:integer | user:keyword |
| --- | --- |
| 4 | u1 |
| 3 | u2 |
| 0 | u3 |
| 2 | u4 |
| 3 | u5 |
| 1 | u6 |
| 0 | u7 |
| 2 | u8 |
| 3 | u9 |

```esql
FROM funnel_events
| STATS level = WINDOW_FUNNEL(15 minutes, @timestamp, action == "view", action == "cart", action == "checkout") BY user, session
| SORT user, session
```

| --- | --- | --- |
| 3 | u1 | s1 |
| 1 | u2 | s2 |
| 3 | u2 | s3 |
| 0 | u3 | s4 |
| 1 | u4 | s5 |
| 2 | u4 | s6 |
| 3 | u5 | s7 |
| 1 | u6 | s8 |
| 0 | u7 | s9 |
| 2 | u8 | s10 |
| 3 | u9 | s11 |
